cards.name: Event Audit Trail: Log scan times by Card UID
cards.desc:
## Summary
As an Admin, I want each RFID scan to be stored with a timestamp and card identifier so I can measure arrivals/departures and produce an audit trail.

## Value
Creates verifiable logs and high-fidelity occupancy data for analytics, compliance, and resource planning.

## Notes
- Canonical event fields should include: event_id (or idempotency key), card_uid, scanner_id, timestamp, decision (allow/deny), optional reason.

## Story Points
5

Source URL: https://trello.com/c/TL82LVPy/10-logging-scan-times-with-id-5

checklists.name: Acceptance Criteria
items: On scan, backend persists an event with card_uid and timestamp
Timestamp is stored in a consistent timezone strategy (UTC recommended) and displayed correctly in UI
Events include scanner_id and allow/deny decision (and reason if denied)
Duplicates are prevented or safely handled (idempotency or de-dupe rules documented)
Basic query support exists for date range and card_uid (even if UI comes later)

cards.name: Admin Console: Manage cards and scanners (CRUD)
cards.desc:
## Summary
As an Admin, I want a single admin console to create, update, and remove scanners and RFID cards so the system’s "source of truth" stays accurate.

## Value
Centralized lifecycle management reduces configuration drift and operational friction.

## Story Points
3

Source URL: https://trello.com/c/FLIbg91Y/18-admin-page-3

checklists.name: Admin Console Checklist
items: View list of scanners and cards
Create new scanner / card
Edit scanner / card fields
Deactivate or delete scanner / card (policy-defined)
Form validation + clear success/error feedback

cards.name: Secure Admin Login (baseline)
cards.desc:
## Summary
As an Admin, I want secure login so that only authorized users can access dashboards and privileged actions.

## Value
Protects sensitive logs/configuration from unauthorized access and reduces risk of malicious changes.

## Story Points
2

Source URL: https://trello.com/c/zYWQBmjb/16-secure-login-2

checklists.name: Acceptance Criteria
items: Unauthenticated users are redirected to login
Authenticated sessions are required for admin routes
Logout invalidates session on client and server (or token expiration enforced)
Basic audit visibility: last login recorded (can be stubbed if tracked elsewhere)

cards.name: Login UX: Validation + error states
cards.desc:
## Summary
As a user, I want clear login validation and error messaging so I can fix issues quickly without guessing.

## Value
Reduces failed-login friction and support burden; improves perceived reliability.

Source URLs:
- https://trello.com/c/5JozErKB/33-wrong-username-message
- https://trello.com/c/9uVZ9Gwa/35-wrong-password-message
- https://trello.com/c/YuiqkFkx/36-missing-username-message
- https://trello.com/c/gTaOWpPg/37-missing-password-message

checklists.name: UI States
items: Missing username -> inline message + focus username field
Missing password -> inline message + focus password field
Wrong username -> generic auth error (avoid user enumeration where possible)
Wrong password -> generic auth error (avoid user enumeration where possible)
Error messages are accessible (ARIA) and consistent styling

cards.name: Account Recovery: Username + password recovery flows
cards.desc:
## Summary
As an Admin, I want recovery options so locked-out users can regain access safely.

## Value
Reduces downtime and avoids manual intervention.

Source URLs:
- https://trello.com/c/grYR4KWc/39-password-recovery
- https://trello.com/c/tIgaEsJY/40-username-recovery

checklists.name: Acceptance Criteria
items: Password reset flow exists (email or admin-mediated, depending on policy)
Username recovery flow exists (if usernames are user-facing; otherwise omit)
Recovery attempts are rate limited and logged
Links/tokens expire and are single-use

cards.name: Account Creation: Secure onboarding w/ DB connection
cards.desc:
## Summary
As a Platform Owner, I want a secure account creation flow that correctly links to the database so new admins can onboard without compromising security.

## Value
Enables controlled onboarding and prevents misconfiguration that could expose data.

Source URL: https://trello.com/c/aZPEwNdV/43-feature-secure-account-creation-w-database-connection-link

checklists.name: Acceptance Criteria
items: Account creation requires an invite or policy-approved constraint
Created accounts are stored in DB with required fields
Default role is least-privileged; elevation requires explicit action
Creation flow validates DB connectivity and surfaces actionable errors

cards.name: Account Lifecycle UI: Create + delete account
cards.desc:
## Summary
As an Admin, I want UI flows to create and delete accounts so I can manage access without touching the database.

## Value
Improves day-to-day administration and access hygiene.

Source URLs:
- https://trello.com/c/WR6ygtHU/48-feature-create-account
- https://trello.com/c/nUbTXayg/46-feature-delete-account
- https://trello.com/c/Rm8chckZ/54-account-creation-ui
- https://trello.com/c/rUQmzAdT/55-account-deletion-ui

checklists.name: UI Acceptance Criteria
items: Create account form with validation + success state
Delete account flow requires confirmation + warns about impact
Errors are specific and actionable (permission denied, network, validation)
UX aligns with role permissions (only authorized admins see these screens)

cards.name: Reporting: Export event data to CSV (UI + API)
cards.desc:
## Summary
As an Admin/Analyst, I want to export event data to CSV so I can analyze scans externally.

## Value
Enables quick offline analysis, sharing, and auditing.

Source URLs:
- https://trello.com/c/DKR4SFOS/53-export-data-as-a-csv
- https://trello.com/c/kxBBFDb9/56-data-export-button

checklists.name: Acceptance Criteria
items: Export action produces a CSV with stable column headers
CSV includes: timestamp, card_uid, scanner_id, decision, reason (if any)
Export respects filters (date range, scanner, card) when present
Large exports handle pagination/streaming or show progress/error

cards.name: Device Authentication: Shared device_secret for scanners
cards.desc:
## Summary
As the backend, I want scanners to authenticate with a shared device_secret so only approved hardware can post events.

## Value
Prevents unauthorized devices from injecting data and improves system integrity.

## Story Points
2

Source URL: https://trello.com/c/VrhUpqgo/27-device-authentication-2

checklists.name: Acceptance Criteria
items: Device requests include device_secret (or derived token) on event POST
Backend rejects missing/invalid secrets with clear error codes
Rotation strategy exists (even if manual) and is documented
Secrets are never returned in API responses or logs

cards.name: Branding: IMPRINT logo asset + usage rules
cards.desc:
## Summary
As a user, I want consistent branding so the dashboard looks polished and trustworthy.

## Value
Improves perceived quality and UI cohesion.

Source URL: https://trello.com/c/1zqS36sG/57-logo

checklists.name: Checklist
items: Logo exists in appropriate formats (SVG preferred, PNG fallback)
Consistent placement (login + dashboard header/nav)
Light/dark theme compatibility
Basic spacing/size guidelines documented

cards.name: RFID Card Data Model: Store multiple fields per card
cards.desc:
## Summary
As the system, I want RFID cards to store multiple fields (e.g., UID, access level, metadata) so authorization and reporting are accurate.

## Value
Enables richer policies and better analytics without schema hacks later.

Source URL: https://trello.com/c/ESQEkfVi/59-store-multiple-fields-of-data-on-a-card

checklists.name: Acceptance Criteria
items: DB schema supports card UID + additional fields (access level, notes, status, etc.)
Backend endpoints can read/update these fields (permissions enforced)
Fields are validated and typed (no unbounded junk fields)
Migration path is documented (seed + local dev setup)

cards.name: Scanner Setup: Wi-Fi selector in frontend (commissioning)
cards.desc:
## Summary
As a Technician, I want a UI to help configure scanner Wi-Fi so devices can be provisioned quickly and consistently.

## Value
Reduces setup time and field errors.

Source URL: https://trello.com/c/d2CnD3P6/63-feature-front-end-wifi-selector-for-card-scenner

checklists.name: Acceptance Criteria
items: UI provides a Wi-Fi selection/config flow compatible with device provisioning approach
Clear success/failure messaging (including common causes)
No secrets are exposed in logs/UI beyond what policy allows
Provisioning steps are documented for technicians

cards.name: Scanner UX: Error messages + recovery guidance
cards.desc:
## Summary
As a user/tech, I want scanner error messages that explain what went wrong and what to do next.

## Value
Reduces troubleshooting time and support escalations.

Source URL: https://trello.com/c/7k77YnYB/73-feature-scanner-error-messages

checklists.name: Error Coverage
items: Offline / cannot reach backend
Invalid device auth / blocked scanner
Card denied (with reason when available)
Hardware fault (RFID read failure) with suggested steps
Messages are consistent across UI and device feedback (LED/buzzer)

cards.name: Authorization Data: Embed access level on card record
cards.desc:
## Summary
As the backend, I want each card to have an access level/preset so authorization decisions can be enforced consistently.

## Value
Enables scalable access policies without custom logic per site.

Source URL: https://trello.com/c/cZY4RV4X/77-feature-card-access-on-card

checklists.name: Acceptance Criteria
items: Card record includes access level/preset reference
Authorization checks use this field when evaluating scans
Admin UI can view/edit access level (role protected)
Denial reasons include policy mismatch when relevant
